name: sol10-catalog-name-wrap
goal: Keep realistic component names inside the mobile catalog viewport

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Current committed CatalogView catalog run f8b87a66 passes 14 cases and fails the long-name mobile case: document scrollWidth 533 exceeds viewport 390. The card title must wrap without clipping.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing component-catalog-previews long state used a descriptive phrase with spaces. Commit 7855771112 replaces it with a realistic unbroken code name while preserving all states and viewport assertions. The existing document-width assertion now detects the missing wrapping.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Formal red f60330ff367abfaaa8bd447f1d1cdcc441ffdc8a730ad01ce4592488d62cd29a at 9e99161805 fails the strengthened card-boundary assertion at all three viewports. The mobile document also remains 533px wide against 390px. No product source changed.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: f0c4dd3184 changes only EntityCard h2 CSS: min-width 0 and overflow-wrap anywhere. The full strengthened test corpus and all fixture inputs remain unchanged.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Paired green df61ef430ab9f35d8a51ba8f4ac32ab5c27d56d33fc7469e84046a993ea50e17 at f0c4dd3184 passes all unchanged catalog cases with the same command and profile as red f60330ff. All 15 API-fetched images were inspected; complete long names now wrap inside their cards at every viewport.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
